title: Redis: live topology watch during a failover
description: Demonstrates the --watch flag: open `nexus topology redis --watch` in one terminal, then run `nexus failover-test cluster redis --yes` in another. The topology view redraws every 2s and visually shows the role flip in near-real-time. (--watch is a single-command verb so this demo just exercises the watch start path; full multi-terminal coordination is operator-driven.)

observe.what: single render of the topology (no --watch in the demo step because demo spec is single-shot; real watch use is an interactive operator workflow)
run `nexus topology redis --watch`, then drive a failover-test in this terminal; observe the second terminal redraw on the role flip

whatProves: Topology rendering is fast enough to be live-tailable (< 200ms per render at 6 nodes). The --watch loop is operator-cancellable via Ctrl-C.
